guardrails-continuation-accounting-and-d.before: Supply a persistent campaign ledger, counted transport and known failed, interrupted and no-response attempts. guardrails-continuation-accounting-and-d.after: Our review-campaign runner keeps a persistent ledger of attempts, reservations and provider receipts (data/ holds the latest export and the receipts that arrived after it) and talks to the provider through a transport that the tests replace with a counting fake. Some earlier attempts failed, were interrupted or got no response. The approval we have covers one review continuation, not upstream generation or a larger cohort. The provider balance on file was read before the last session. No real provider calls are allowed.

system-design-review-existing-proposal.before: The proposal uses a browser chat client, a Python ADK service on Cloud Run, a shared document index and an external booking API. It currently takes tenant_id directly from browser JSON, filters document results only after retrieval, and retries a booking timeout with a newly generated operation ID. The accepted product constraints require identity-derived tenant scope, authorization before document access and approval bound to the exact booking change. The provider's replay and reconciliation support remains unknown. The user authorizes reading local artifacts and revising architecture documents, not application edits or external requests.
system-design-review-existing-proposal.after: The proposal is docs/architecture/proposal.md: a browser chat client, a Python ADK service on Cloud Run, a shared document index and an external booking API, with prototype code under app/ and web/. The accepted product constraints are in docs/architecture/constraints.md. Whether the booking provider supports replaying a request or looking up an operation's outcome is still unknown. The user authorizes reading local artifacts and revising architecture documents, not application edits or external requests.

system-design-runtime-and-release-review.before: React, OIDC and PostgreSQL are accepted. Three replicas persist conversation events but send only the last 20 events to the model, which the proposal calls history deletion. Exports use replica-local temporary disk. Tool results are paired by tool name, any final-response event marks success, and reconnect resubmits the message. Per-process session locks and immediate reservation release on browser disconnect are proposed. A gradual SDK rollout will change the session storage format. Only a design review is authorized.
system-design-runtime-and-release-review.after: React, OIDC and PostgreSQL are accepted. The runtime proposal for the reporting assistant, including the planned SDK upgrade, is docs/architecture/reporting-assistant.md. Only a design review is authorized.
